automation.title: Vent automation
automation.description: Follows the printer’s commanded bed temperature. No filament identification is required.
automation.sealHelp: Below this target, vents open while printing. At or above it, the chamber stays sealed.
automation.cooldownHelp: After a print, vent residual heat until the bed cools below the lower threshold.
automation.materialHelp: Use material reported by an AMS or Klipper printer when available. Unknown material falls back to the bed-temperature threshold above.

lighting.title: Vent and chamber lights
lighting.description: LED indices 0–10 control the vent lights. Indices 11–15 control the relocated front LEDs used as chamber lighting.
